implementation.androidDriver: Official SQLDelight AndroidSqliteDriver2.4.1 wraps raw Android SQLiteDatabase via an internal public-API SupportSQLiteDatabase bridge (AndroidX's own raw wrapper is internal). Pool FK configuration, no localized-collator metadata rewrite, no SQLiteOpenHelper automatic create/version/migration/downgrade, and a custom non-deleting corruption handler. The unchanged ClientStorage boundary alone owns validation and transactional create/generated migration/user_version publication. Main-thread open is rejected before I/O. Default path is private noBackupFilesDir/client-storage/replica.db; no seeded account/game/catalog or alternate launcher.
implementation.launcherLifecycle: MainActivity gets a production AndroidViewModel from the ordinary activity store. One owned executor opens/retries and later closes the repository; rotation retains that owner. Failed opens expose only structured reasons and safe UI text/Retry, with newer schemas directing update without uninstall. Retry opens the same file only from failure, never concurrently or as a repair loop. onCleared queues close behind in-flight open, shuts down/drains the worker without waiting on UI, and fences late presentation callbacks. Repository never escapes to a Composable. Full account/logout callback fences remain I02/I03.
implementation.privacy: Manifest allowBackup=false plus explicit legacy and Android12+ cloud/device-transfer exclusions cover all nine supported private/device-encrypted/external domains. Actual aapt2 APK resource IDs resolve to those exact complete XML rules; source/compiled trees agree, and missing-domain mutations fail validation. No-backup database includes journal/sidecars; future files/preferences/credentials excluded by default. Refetchable public cache remains logically separate, not required accepted data. No claim of exercised OEM backup transport or implemented credentials.
implementation.instrumentation: 14 compiled tests in approved normal-app androidTest paths. Nine production-driver file-backed tests cover fresh/exact commit/reopen, real SQL atomic rollback of writes/removals/new cursor, cache/personal separation, populated shared-v1 migration, actual third-statement failure after ALTERs with byte/schema/version preservation and retry, future/unversioned/malformed/corrupt refusal, two-worker FK and close behavior, no-backup path and UI-thread refusal. Three actual controller tests cover corrupt failure/retry, retained future-version refusal/compatible retry, close/drain during open with no late UI publication. Two normal MainActivity tests cover startup and recreation retention. Fixture database is shared from the retained migration verifier as androidTest-only assets, not copied into the main APK. UUID-scoped test cleanup never deletes launcher data. These tests are COMPILED NOT EXECUTED until I01f; documentation supplies the exact focused connectedDebugAndroidTest command without reversing dependencies.

developmentDiagnostics: Initial two builds failed SDK36 Kotlin nullability at rawQueryWithFactory's unused editTable argument. The first tentative nullColumnHack change did not address that location and was undone; setting unused editTable to an empty string fixes compilation without changing SQL/bind behavior. Both failing outputs retained, subsequent build and clean final build pass.

New artifact checker initially expected aapt2's old typed boolean rendering and package-prefixed resource names. Actual SDK36 output uses allowBackup=false and bare xml/name.
